# /crav1-add-to-spec

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From new information to an existing spec](../../from-add.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-add-to-spec/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Add new information to one existing spec, then report whether docs/system/ or another spec has to change; edits there only on apply.

New information aimed at one spec that already exists is **[`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md)**. [`/crav1-tighten-spec`](crav1-tighten-spec.md) stays for mushy wording. Match, intake, spark, and ideas create the folders. This command does not plan.

New information for one existing spec → quote it into that `spec.md`, then report whether the landscape or another spec has to change. Does not rewrite those other files unless asked. Does not create a glossary. A new glossary row can be one listed edit and is not written unless apply is chosen. A meaning the new information does not state is `to be researched`. Existing rows are not rewritten. Does not plan, implement, or commit.

## Runs when

New information for one existing spec. Called by the user, by [`/crav1-environment-read`](crav1-environment-read.md) for a confirmed Match section, by [`/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code`](crav1-suggest-tests-for-code.md) for one kept or dismissed suggestion, by [`/crav1-meeting-to-specs`](crav1-meeting-to-specs.md) for one kept addition, by [`/crav1-specs-to-ado`](crav1-specs-to-ado.md) for a preview change, and by [`/crav1-ado-to-specs`](crav1-ado-to-specs.md) for one kept change or one answer.

## Reads

In short: That information and one `spec.md`.

Reads the new information and one existing `spec.md`.

## Writes

In short: Quotes in that spec, `Used by` on a note it quotes, `docs/sources/` for an imported source, the transfer data policy after a yes, research stale marks after a yes, and answer links under open questions.

Writes quotes into that file, and listed edits to `docs/system/` or another spec only when the user picks apply, including a new row on an existing glossary. When that information is an imported source, also writes `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/` following this skill’s `references/sources.md`, and `Source:` and `Trace:` lines that link to that folder. That check may write the transfer data policy after a yes. Cursor: `.cursor/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.mdc`. Claude Code project: `.claude/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.md`. It never writes a secrets choice into that file. For a mail, it lists each embedded image, inline or attached. It recommends convert to text when the image is a diagram, a table, or text that can be reproduced exactly, and compress otherwise. It asks once before the source folder is written. Auto-accept applies to those recommendations only when the transfer data policy clearly covers them. A meeting handoff that already wrote the folder only adds those lines. When the quote comes from a note in `docs/notes/`, writes `Used by <slug>` on that note and updates the index. Status stays open. `Absorbed by <slug>` only when one spec takes the whole note, and only after the user says yes. Then status is absorbed. A listed `repos.md` edit keeps `Synced at` and does not set it. After a kept quote, compares it with `docs/research/*.md` and `## Research findings` on the specs it touches, including notes those findings link to, following this skill’s `references/research-stale.md`. A clear contradiction or an answered open question is marked stale only after the user says yes. An unclear case is not marked. When pointed at an updated note in `docs/research/`, or when this run writes one, checks each listed point and clears, narrows, or routes it. An older mark with no point lines is split into the hits it was made from. It also routes the note's own open questions when the answer lies outside the note's owner, including when the mark clears. It does not ask the user. A kept quote that answers a waiting point is re-checked the same way. It may draft a revisit request for the note's owner. It does not send it. A clear answer to an open question on the target spec writes an `Answered:` line under it, and an import from [`/crav1-meeting-to-specs`](crav1-meeting-to-specs.md) can hand answer links and asked marks, following this skill's `references/open-questions.md`. Neither rewrites the question or a spec line. An answer that changes a spec line names [`/crav1-resolve-questions`](crav1-resolve-questions.md) and does not run it.

## Does not

Leaves `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, and a missing `glossary.md` alone. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: creates no slug and no `docs/system/`. When the quote comes from a note, writes `Used by <slug>` and updates `docs/notes/index.md`. Status stays open. `Absorbed by <slug>` only when one spec takes the whole note, and only after the user says yes. Then status is absorbed. Partial use never closes it. The research question is not the landscape apply question. The environment-read and suggest-tests-for-code handoffs ask once at the end of the run, not per item, whether to run [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md), and do not run it. The specs-to-ado and ado-to-specs handoffs do not ask. The meeting handoff runs this research check. It does not run it a second time.

- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
